quotes.text: Lunkerdog is top notch, very knowledgeable and overall, one of the best fishing guides we’ve had the opportunity of fishing with. We boarded Jeff’s boat around 4:30 pm and within 15 minutes, we had Tarpon making our live mullet dance across the top of the water. For the next 5 – 6 hours, we experienced one strike after another and had about 6 good hook-ups, getting 2 to the boat between 30 – 60 lbs. We had so many strikes that we lost count!

Thanks for a great time on the water Tarpon fishing this past Monday, May 4th. My wife Jauna and I both enjoyed the trip and will definitely plan another trip with you soon! (Maybe this fall during the months of September or October) I have given your name to a few friends so you may be getting some additional calls from N.C.

Jeff’s knowledge of what it takes to catch big Tarpon in South Florida was evident when another boat pulled up to fish where we had been fishing all afternoon, and they couldn’t even get a strike. If you want to catch Tarpon in South Florida with the best fishing guide, we highly recommend Lunkerdog, Capt. Jeff!
